standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there. Looking for some supplies?

during-the-heart-of-darkness.npc: Hello there. Looking for some supplies?

options.text: I hear you can offer help to those in need.

steps.player: I hear you can offer help to those in need.

steps.npc: Well I'm always happy to help those less fortunate than I, but you don't really look like you need that sort of thing.

steps.player: I'm not sure if I should be insulted by that, or flattered... But anyway, you misunderstand. I'm not looking for help myself. Instead I was hoping to do some helping alongside you.

steps.npc: Thank you for the offer, but I'm not really looking for help right now.

steps.player: Are you sure? I do also quite like death.
You know, end of the world, holy fire, final dawns, that sort of thing.

steps.npc: Are you a fool? Keep your voice down!

steps.player: Look, I'm not here to cause problems. I just want to help.

steps.npc: You want to join the Emissaries?
You know there are tests you'd need to pass, right? Not everyone can be considered worthy.

steps.player: Fine by me. I love tests!

steps.npc: There is a penalty for failing them.

steps.player: Okay, not quite as fun, but I'm still up for it.

steps.npc: Well... if you're sure, fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.

during-the-heart-of-darkness-talking-to-.npc: Hello there. Looking for some supplies?

steps.npc: I already told you to keep your voice down! Fetch your friend and then head east to the Twilight Temple. I will send word for them to expect you both.
